column1: # publication: RSF World Press Freedom Index 2026

# period: RSF describes each Index as "a snapshot of the situation during the calendar year (January-December) prior to its publication" (https://rsf.org/en/methodology-used-compiling-world-press-freedom-index-2026)

column2: so the scores were read from Wikipedia's copy of the 2026 table. Medium rather than high for that reason; the scores were cross-checked against independent readings of the same Index before being kept.
never the rank. A rank moves when other countries move; the score is the country's own.
